description: Asks how æ/ae/Æ/AE subjects (Pat group p07) match literal and wildcard patterns (ae, æ, AE, a?, ?e, a*, *e, æ*, ?, ??) and '=' against 'ae', in one LIKE projection. A second projection asks the class patterns [æa], [aæ], a[ef], [!æa], [!aæ], [æa]e, [æa]x and [æa]?, under the General sort order. Fixture r-expr-1-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: SELECT Id, S, S LIKE 'ae' AS m0, S LIKE 'æ' AS m1, S LIKE 'AE' AS m2, S LIKE 'a?' AS m3, S LIKE '?e' AS m4, S LIKE 'a*' AS m5, S LIKE '*e' AS m6, S LIKE 'æ*' AS m7, S LIKE '?' AS m8, S LIKE '??' AS m9, S = 'ae' AS eq FROM Pat WHERE G = 'p07' ORDER BY Id

SELECT Id, S, S LIKE '[æa]' AS m0, S LIKE '[aæ]' AS m1, S LIKE 'a[ef]' AS m2, S LIKE '[!æa]' AS m3, S LIKE '[!aæ]' AS m4, S LIKE '[æa]e' AS m5, S LIKE '[æa]x' AS m6, S LIKE '[æa]?' AS m7 FROM Pat WHERE G = 'p07' ORDER BY Id
